_doc: The San Diego freeway network (I-5 / SR-52 / SR-163 / I-8, both carriageways and every ramp; shipped as san_diego_freeway_v0.5.0) through the chain (tools/ship_track.sh; docs/ONE-CHAIN.md §4 row 8, Kevin 2026-10-28: 'rebuild, by an agent'). The draft is the network draft scripts/build_network.sh ran as net -> classify -> elev -> mesh, as chain steps: net (Overpass, source.bbox / highways / refs) -> classify (OSM class, lanes, layer) -> network_elev (3DEP along every edge + the terrain grid) -> network_mesh (data/track.obj: 1ROAD / 1WALL / 1RUNOFF / 1GRASS tiles, flyover decks) -> network_reference (track.config.json network.reference_line: the ONE real mainline the ship phase walks, from the draft's own edges -> centerline.local.json, finished_centerline.json, dummies.json, network.reference.json) -> underlay (data/track.obj into loop.blend as GEN_*). Never build_network_env: no generated furniture. Authoring happens in that blend (AUTH_*), the prep / exporter / spawn builder run from airoso's scripts/ac, the gates run on the BUILT kn5. The workshop lives OUTSIDE airoso.
_owed: First pass = the draft through the chain, no authoring yet. WHAT IS JUDGED, WHAT IS NOT (2026-11-01): the ship phase walks ONE line, the reference line track.config.json network.reference_line declares (I 8 eastbound end to end, resolved from the draft's own edges by scripts.geometry.network_reference — the draft step network_reference, before the underlay). Along it: the prep's gate line, write_ai_line's fast_lane.ai (a GENERATED draft, ledger 0023), verify_kn5's spawns (grid at its start, AC_TIME_0 at its finish: L11), drive_test's ten wheel paths, audit_mesh check H. On the WHOLE mesh, every edge: audit_mesh A-K (but H), verify_kn5's duplicate / face-down / vertex-cap / terrain-poke checks, kn5_ground_check. NOT JUDGED: every other built edge — I 8 westbound, I 5, CA 52, CA 163 both ways, every ramp and interchange connector — is in track.obj and the kn5 but no line-walking gate drives it (no drive_test wheel path, no AI line, no spawn): data/network.reference.json 'unjudged' lists each by id, name, class and length, and drive_test prints the list on every run. The minimap draws every edge (make_map reads data/network.edges.local.json). Found by the stand-in (Lake Murray's I 8 eastbound, 2026-11-01): the network draft gives a shared junction node two heights where two edges meet (0.13-0.60 m pavement steps at all four mainline joints: scripts.elevation.network_elev smooths each edge open-ended) — drive_test reads them as severe steps; fixed 2026-11-03 behind track.config.json network.join_nodes (ledger 0075, second addendum: one height per shared node, at grade and for the deck lift), with network.stable_snap (one coordinate, one node, per OSM layer) and scenery.walls.seat 'seated'. Gantries, Mission Bay's water, the Pacific plane and lane-level detail are authoring items, never build_network_env.
